name: Gambling Den
author: Oddisz
description: Sell ships for tokens at any port of size 6 or more. Play Slots, multi-ball Pachinko, Pinball, Blackjack, or Relic Jackpot. Pinball has three balls per entry, mouse-controlled flippers, and targeted score rewards. Pachinko targets hullmods, weapons, tokens, or credits, with a high-risk token board. Slots include fighter LPCs and rare story points; Relic Jackpot pays colony items and AI cores. Hullmod rewards skip blueprints you know or carry. LunaLib controls payouts and an optional Pachinko anime background.
